title: Kitchens and workflows
intro: Route fired items to the right kitchen stations and define how orders move through preparation stages.

sections.title: Kitchens
sections.intro: Kitchens group dishes and link to printers for kitchen tickets.
steps: Create kitchen stations (e.g. Grill, Bar, Pastry).
Assign dishes and printers so tickets route to the correct station.
sections.caption: Kitchens maintenance table.

sections.title: Workflows
sections.intro: Workflows define order-status steps used by kitchen and order-display screens.
steps: Create or edit workflow steps and transitions.
Link workflows to order types or kitchens as required by your venue setup.
sections.caption: Workflows tab.

sections.title: Kitchen form
sections.intro: Kitchens route dishes to printers and inventory locations.
steps: Add name, priority, linked printers, and dishes.
Save — new items print to this station when assigned on dishes.
sections.caption: Kitchen station form.

fields.name: Name
fields.effect: Station label on KOT and order display.

fields.name: Printers
fields.effect: Devices that print tickets for this kitchen.

sections.title: Workflow form
sections.intro: Workflows chain kitchen stages for order display and bump bars.
steps: Name the workflow and add ordered stages.
Assign a kitchen to each stage.
Link workflow on dishes that need multi-step prep.
sections.caption: Workflow stages editor.

fields.name: Name
fields.effect: Workflow identifier on dishes and displays.
